mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM professor_appointment WHERE user_id=#{userId}) appointments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM professor_appointment WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='待确认') pending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_plan WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='进行中') activePlans, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_message WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND is_read=0) unreadMessages

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM professor_appointment WHERE professor_id=#{professorId}) appointments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM professor_appointment WHERE professor_id=#{professorId} AND status='待确认') pending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_record WHERE professor_id=#{professorId}) consultations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_evaluation WHERE professor_id=#{professorId}) evaluations

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role='USER') users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM professor_profile WHERE audit_status='待审核') pendingProfessors, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM professor_appointment) appointments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_resource WHERE audit_status='待审核') pendingResources

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(appointment_time,'%Y-%m') month,COUNT(*) value FROM professor_appointment WHERE appointment_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 11 MONTH) AND user_id=#{userId}AND professor_id=#{professorId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(appointment_time,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
